title: C3 G1 Large-Scale Crossed Differential and Generative Falsification Campaign
generator_independence_rules: The G1 profile generator must not import, copy, call, or introspect any W7 or W8 parser, validator, executor, canonicalizer, graph builder, trace builder, C2 normalizer, replay implementation, or target builder.
The generator may use only the frozen public C3 profile/wire rules, literal finite domains, and the six literal one-byte payloads already ALLOWed by the frozen F0 claim: 01, 02, 03, aa, bb, ff.
Expected direct traces for ordinary random profiles must not be computed by a hidden reference implementation. The crossed square is the executable differential oracle.
Metamorphic expectations must arise only from syntactic transformations whose required relation is stated in this frozen campaign before execution.

No generated failure may be deleted, skipped, xfailed, reseeded, or replaced merely to obtain a green campaign. Any semantic defect in this campaign requires a numbered pre-authority amendment that preserves the failing seed and scenario index.
crossed_square_required_for_every_closur: W7 direct C3 ordered trace map equals W8 direct C3 ordered trace map pointwise including payload order and multiplicity
W7-generated CBTNF-v1 bytes equal W8-generated CBTNF-v1 bytes exactly
W8 replay of the exact W7-generated CBTNF-v1 bytes equals the W7 direct ordered trace map
W7 replay of the exact W8-generated CBTNF-v1 bytes equals the W8 direct ordered trace map
W7 projected K1 REALIZE equals W8 projected K1 REALIZE
W5 reconstruction from W7-generated C2 evidence equals the direct C3 K1 projection
W6 reconstruction from W7-generated C2 evidence equals the direct C3 K1 projection
W5 reconstruction from W8-generated C2 evidence equals the direct C3 K1 projection
W6 reconstruction from W8-generated C2 evidence equals the direct C3 K1 projection

structured_valid_distribution.boundary_slots: 0 through 3 user slots; domain sizes 2 through 4 when present; exact frozen two-world claim world set always retained
structured_valid_distribution.state_cells: 1 through 4 cells; finite domains 2 through 4; initialization may be const, declared input, or @world only when the exact destination domain is compatible
structured_valid_distribution.tables: 0 through 3 total finite tables; arity 1 through 3; exact Cartesian row coverage; table formal names independent of machine source names
structured_valid_distribution.effects: one through four ordered effects on each terminating point, with deliberate duplicate payload occurrences represented in a nonzero fraction
structured_valid_distribution.construction_rule: ordinary valid profiles are terminating by construction rather than by consulting W7/W8 execution results

metamorphic_relations.transformation: permute JSON object keys plus world/state/table/block declaration order and table row order only where the frozen wire declares order nonsemantic
rename table formal arguments consistently without changing row tuple positions or APPLY_TABLE source bindings
insert a new syntactically valid unreachable block containing profile-valid operations only
on a generated multi-effect reachable block, either swap two adjacent distinct payloads or duplicate one payload occurrence without changing the underlying payload set when possible
required: if the payload set is unchanged then K1 REALIZE equal

negative_mutation_families: bind APPLY_TABLE source whose exact domain differs from the formal domain
construct an exact repeated block+full-state configuration after an emitted prefix
shrink a downstream C2 slot domain after source acceptance and re-sign C2 evidence
perturb generated C2 bytes while retaining stale artifact or target identity
inject a valid but non-ALLOWed payload and require the forbidden consequence to survive faithful reconstruction
add producer-style completeness/REALIZE/target assertions and require them to carry no authority

stress_requirements_over_192_profiles.rule: stress profiles must remain within qualified C2 program-byte and gas limits; explicit limit-overflow belongs to the negative lane and must fail closed

campaign_integrity: Every shard writes a deterministic digest over seed, scenario IDs, exact generated source bytes, scenario class, and observed disposition.
The aggregate gate fails unless all eight expected shard digests are present and all precommitted scenario counts are exact.
Coverage counters are computed from generator construction metadata before checker execution, not inferred from successful checker outputs.
Any W7/W8 crash, timeout, malformed output, disagreement, replay mismatch, W5/W6 disagreement, skipped scenario, or missing shard is a campaign failure.
The 62 frozen F0 gate remains separately green and is not replaced by G1.
promotion_effect: Passing G1 is additional non-authoritative falsification evidence only. It is necessary input to a later C3 qualification decision but does not itself create a production C3 proof kind or preservation authority.
nonclaims: G1 does not prove absence of all common-mode bugs.
G1 does not prove arbitrary native programs refine MFST.
G1 does not add ambient capabilities, concurrency, unbounded nondeterminism, remote attestation, or hardware trust.
G1 does not change K1 semantics or qualified C2 semantics.
A green random campaign is evidence against the tested bug classes and generated distribution, not a universal correctness theorem.
